issue_title: [Feature] 添加日志记录功能支持

red_phase.description: Write failing regression tests for logging feature

green_phase.description: Implement minimal logging support in storage.py
changes: Add import logging at module level
Add optional logger parameter to TodoStorage.__init__ (defaults to None)
Add DEBUG logging in load() for path, record count, and timing
Add DEBUG logging in save() for path, record count, and atomic write success

implementation_sequence: 1. Create test file tests/test_issue_5257_logging.py with failing tests
2. Run pytest to confirm tests fail (RED)
4. Modify TodoStorage.__init__ to accept optional logger parameter
5. Add DEBUG logging in load() method
6. Add DEBUG logging in save() method
7. Run pytest to confirm tests pass (GREEN)
8. Run ruff check for linting compliance
acceptance_criteria: TodoStorage class supports optional logger parameter
load() logs record count and timing at DEBUG level when logger provided
save() logs record count and atomic write success at DEBUG level when logger provided
No logger parameter means no logging output (backward compatible)
